name: Old Documentary Reel
description: A raw, old-camera found-footage documentary template — clapperboard slates, archive photography, grain and tracking-roll damage, chipped-edge title cards. Not clean or modern; built for history, true-crime, and archival storytelling.
_incremental_build_note: All 8 scene layouts are implemented end-to-end in both trees + all render-critical registries (Root.tsx, templateConfig.tsx, registry.json). Still pending: the 4 remaining named transitions (Countdown Wipe, Splice Jump-Cut, Light-Leak Dissolve, Vintage Motorcar Wipe — only Grain Crossfade is wired, used for every boundary), the full 10-effect archive-effects module (several primitives exist in docReelStyle.tsx already: grain, weave, tracking roll, sprockets, halation, scanlines, light leak, dust & scratches — Reel-Change Cue, Editor's Grease Pencil, Signal Ghost, Newsreel Wipe are not yet built as distinct effects), and preview-gallery thumbnail components (OldDocumentaryReelPreview + portrait variant) so the template appears in the template picker gallery.

fields.label: Count From
fields.description: Highest number the leader counts down from (3 = a 3-2-1 leader). Each number holds for one second, so this also sets the scene's length.

scene_defaults.title: The Investigation Begins
scene_defaults.narration: Every case starts with a single frame, a name, a date, and the quiet certainty that something here was never fully explained.

fields.label: Slate Scene
fields.description: Scene number shown on the clapperboard.

fields.label: Slate Take
fields.description: Take number shown on the clapperboard.

fields.label: Slate Date
fields.description: Date shown on the clapperboard, in an old production-log style (e.g. 07.14.86).

fields.label: Slate Director
fields.description: Director name shown on the clapperboard.

fields.label: Slate Production
fields.description: Production title shown on the clapperboard.

fields.label: Production Field Label
fields.description: Label word for the production row, defaults to "PRODUCTION".

fields.label: Scene Field Label
fields.description: Label word for the scene row, defaults to "SCENE".

fields.label: Take Field Label
fields.description: Label word for the take row, defaults to "TAKE".

fields.label: Director Field Label
fields.description: Label word for the director row, defaults to "DIRECTOR".

fields.label: Date Field Label
fields.description: Label word for the date row, defaults to "DATE".

scene_defaults.title: By the numbers
scene_defaults.narration: The scale of it only becomes clear once the individual files are laid side by side against the record investigators kept for nearly forty years.

sample_props.statContext: Each file was cross-referenced against the original 1986 archive, revealing a pattern of missed connections investigators had overlooked for nearly a decade.

fields.label: Stat Value
fields.description: The large number or figure displayed, e.g. "47" or "12%".

fields.label: Stat Label
fields.description: Short label describing what the statistic measures.

fields.label: Stat Context
fields.description: One sentence of supporting context or source.

scene_defaults.title: A Town Divided
scene_defaults.narration: Some places carry their history in plain sight, written into the storefronts and the silences of people who still remember exactly what happened.

fields.label: Chapter Title
fields.description: Overrides the on-screen title text if set.

scene_defaults.title: Field Report
scene_defaults.narration: The paperwork tells its own version of events, one filled with gaps, crossed-out names, and a timeline that never quite adds up.

sample_props.dossierBody: Subject was last confirmed seen departing the north gate at approximately 22:40. Security logs show no further contact after that point, and no forced entry was recorded at the residence.

fields.label: Dossier Heading
fields.description: Heading printed at the top of the report insert.

fields.label: Dossier Body
fields.description: Typewritten body text of the report, revealed with a typing effect.

fields.label: Dossier Stamp
fields.description: This scene's actual verdict as a 1-2 word rubber stamp, derived from this scene's own title/narration/visual description and dossierBody — the outcome that body reports (e.g. "FAILED", "SHIPPED", "RESOLVED", "DEPRECATED"). Not generic officialdom like "VERIFIED".

fields.label: Classification
fields.description: What kind of document dossierBody reads like, in the subject's own vocabulary (e.g. "Benchmark", "Advisory", "Post-Mortem", "Specification"). Derived from this scene's own content, not generic filler like "Internal" or "Restricted".

scene_defaults.title: The Photograph
scene_defaults.narration: A single frame, held just long enough to matter, capturing a street that would look completely different only a few years later.

sample_props.caption: Main Street, looking east
sample_props.subCaption: Photographer unknown. The print was taken sometime in the early 1970s, most likely in autumn based on the shadows and the awnings visible over the storefronts. This stretch of Main Street was demolished within the decade to make way for the municipal parking structure, and no other photographs of the block are known to survive in any public or private collection. A handwritten note on the back of the original print, since lost, reportedly identified the corner as the site of a small dispute over a delivery route the previous winter.

fields.label: Caption
fields.description: Primary caption for the photograph.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: The main archival description of the photograph — write a genuinely long, detailed multi-sentence account (4+ sentences: what the image shows, when and where it was taken, who took it if known, and why it matters to the story). This is the layout's primary text content, not a short credit line.

fields.label: Panel Heading
fields.description: Small heading at the top of the record panel, defaults to "ARCHIVE PHOTOGRAPH". Leave unset unless the source calls for different terminology (e.g. "HOME MOVIE STILL").

scene_defaults.title: The Negatives
scene_defaults.narration: Dozens of frames from that same afternoon, and only one that the investigators ever circled — the one nobody could fully explain.

sample_props.contactSheetNotes: Dozens of frames from that same roll survive in the case file, most of them unremarkable — a stretch of road, a parked car, the same intersection shot three times from slightly different angles. Only one frame was ever circled by an investigator, and the report never explains why. The rest were logged, sleeved, and never looked at again until now.

fields.label: Contact Sheet Images
fields.description: Up to 9 image URLs shown as a contact-sheet grid.

fields.label: Case Notes Body
fields.description: The main body text of the CASE NOTES panel — write a genuinely long, detailed multi-sentence note. Falls back to the global narration if left empty.

scene_defaults.title: Eyewitness
scene_defaults.narration: She remembers it like it was yesterday, the sound before the sirens, and the strange quiet that followed for the rest of that week.

sample_props.interviewQuote: I heard the sirens before I saw anything at all, and by the time I got to the window, half the street was already outside.

fields.label: Quote
fields.description: The spoken quote shown in the lower-third.

fields.label: Subject Name
fields.description: Name of the person quoted.

fields.label: Subject Role
fields.description: Their role or relation, e.g. "Former Resident".

scene_defaults.title: What We Know So Far
scene_defaults.narration: A short list of confirmed facts, ticked off one by one as investigators worked to separate what they actually knew from what people assumed.

fieldNotesItems: No forced entry found at the residence.
Vehicle recovered eight miles north, undamaged.
Two witnesses report the same description.

fields.label: Heading
fields.description: Heading at the top of the notebook page. Falls back to the scene title if unset.

fields.label: Checklist Items
fields.description: Up to 7 short, independent facts, each shown as a ticked checklist row. Not a sequence or timeline — each item stands alone.

scene_defaults.title: The Official Story Had a Problem
scene_defaults.narration: Every record that survived told a slightly different version of the same night.

essayStatements: The official story had a problem.
Nobody could agree on the timeline.
And the one witness who could was never interviewed.

fields.label: Statements
fields.description: Short, blunt declarative statements (2-6, sized to the argument—don't pad to a fixed count) that accumulate on screen one below the last, each staying visible. Each should stand alone as a complete assertion, not a fragment of a longer sentence.

fields.label: Description Font Size
fields.description: Drives the brand/credit line and the website button beneath the end card.

fields.label: Brand Name
fields.description: Production/brand name shown beneath the end card.
